business_scope.primary_industry_name: Physical Grocery Store Retailing of Imported Asian Condiments and Veg

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company Registry, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law influence, and codified customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: World Trade Organization (WTO) — Vanuatu acceded on 24 August 2012
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) — in force for Vanuatu
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement — in force
No standalone Double Taxation Agreement (DTA) in force, consistent with Vanuatu's tax-exempt regime for International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 32 of 1993, as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 20 of 2014, as amended; Companies (Amendment) Act No. 34 of 2020 and Limited Liability Companies (Amendment) Act No. 35 of 2020, requiring mandatory beneficial-ownership information filing with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); VFSC AML/CFT Rules and sectoral Guidance; Business Licence Act [Cap. 110]; Biosecurity and Customs legislation for import controls applicable to grocery commodities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Name Reservation of the Vanuatu International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs where the receiving foreign authority is in a Hague Apostille Convention jurisdiction; otherwise Consular Legalization via the Vanuatu diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency for directors, shareholders, and officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: VFSC and the licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for cross-border banking or counterparty filing; Consular Legalization for non-Hague receiving jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and UBO identity and address evidence (directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the origin country is a 1961 Hague Convention Contracting Party) or Consular Legalization by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs; English or French certified translation required for non-English/French documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Comfort Letter and Registered Office Confirmation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille when required by foreign financial institutions; otherwise accepted domestically as a registry-issued compliance document

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, authorized signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and Australian DFAT Consolidated List; mandatory Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) status determination and risk classification under the AML/CFT Act No. 20 of 2014; enhanced due diligence required for any PEP, sanctions-hit jurisdiction, or high-risk jurisdiction connection; ongoing monitoring during the corporate lifecycle; all AML/CFT records retained for a minimum of five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu (official registry portal: vfsc.vu); name reservations are processed exclusively through a licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be submitted in Latin-script English or French. A non-Latin script (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic) may be used only as a supplementary transliteration and must not form the sole registered name. The name must be distinguishable from all existing registered company names and must not be identical or deceptively similar to a name reserved or registered in Vanuatu. The name must include a statutory limited-liability designator: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or 'Société Anonyme' (including abbreviations thereof).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection by the Registrar of International Companies, the licensed Registered Agent may request written reasons and apply for informal reconsideration within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. If reconsideration is refused, a formal administrative appeal may be filed with the Registrar, and thereafter judicial review may be sought before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu, ordinarily within 28 days, under the applicable civil procedure and administrative law rules. To preserve the transaction timeline, an alternative compliant name should be reserved immediately in parallel; a reserved name that lapses after 30 days is released and requires a new filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is NOT permissible for the licensed physical retail grocery segment: the Asian Supermarket Grocery Hub must maintain a physical leased storefront and commercial substance under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 110]. A virtual registered address is permissible only for the statutory IC registered office at the licensed agent's premises in Port Vila.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: MODERATE-HIGH: approximately 25% annualized risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection of the licensed retail premises by the Port Vila Municipal Council, VFSC, Department of Finance, and Vanuatu Biosecurity; retail trade licenses attached to imported food products are typically inspected at least once per licence year.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Revised Edition 2020) – ss. 2, 8, 10, 15; Companies (International Companies) Regulations 2012
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (submitted with Application for Incorporation as an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; US$1 par value share permitted; no escrow or paid-up capital requirement is applicable to an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: I, the undersigned, being the sole incorporator of Asian Supermarket Grocery Hub IC, convene the first meeting of the Board. RESOLVED that the subscriber's subscription for one Class A share be approved and allotted. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office at the address supplied by the licensed agent be adopted and filed. FURTHER RESOLVED that the initial Directors and Secretary be appointed and that the Director maintain statutory registers and the company seal. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered agent be engaged as required by the International Companies Act. All actions already taken to effectuate these resolutions are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Online Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through a licensed VFSC registered agent, specifying 'Asian Supermarket Grocery Hub' and no less than two alternative names. Pay the prescribed name reservation fee and obtain written pre-clearance from VFSC confirming the proposed name is not distinguishable from an existing International Company and is not misleading or contrary to public interest.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Copy of the proposed Memorandum and Articles cover sheet
Consent letter from the registered agent
Identity copy of the proposed director/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a fresh application with alternative names. A formal reconsideration request may be filed with the VFSC Registrar under the International Companies Act, Cap 222, s. 8(5) within 14 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Services Division (submission through licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association, including name, capital structure, registered office, objects, and governance clauses. The document must be signed by at least one subscriber, and the subscriber's signature must be witnessed by a notary public or a licensed VFSC agent. Retain the wet-ink original and prepare a certified electronic copy for filing.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (original or certified copy)
Incumbency and consent of the registered agent
Statement of compliance by the registered agent
Voter identification or passport copy for each subscriber
Notarized power of attorney if the subscriber is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises a documentary query, file a formal response or amended document through the registered agent within 7 working days. Re-execution and re-vertering may be required to correct signatures or dates.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Incorporation Application and Pay State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Public Registry Window / Online Filing System via registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the Application for Incorporation as an International Company together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, agent consent, and statutory declarations. Pay the government filing fee of USD 500 and the prescribed annual registry fee. Upon receipt, VFSC verifies the availability of the name and the completeness of the documents.
required_dossiers: Application for Incorporation as an International Company (form IC-1)
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent consent and contact details
Registered office consent letter
Proof of payment of filing fee
Declaration by subscriber as to lawful activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to incomplete documentation, correct the deficiencies within 10 working days or the application lapses. Re-application may be made with a fresh fee if the initial application is rejected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation, which is the conclusive evidence of incorporation and the legal entity's formation. Verify that the certificate shows the company number, the date of incorporation, the name, and that the company is incorporated as an International Company under the International Companies Act, Cap 222.
required_dossiers: VFSC receipt or notice of issue
Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
Certificate of Incorporation (original issued by VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error, apply to VFSC for rectification under the Act; provide the original certificate and an explanatory statutory declaration. If the certificate is delayed, pursue written follow-up through the registered agent and escalate to the VFSC Inquiries Officer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt Registered Office and Appoint Initial Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registered Agent and Corporate Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Formally confirm the registered office address and the appointment of the initial Director, Secretary, and Registered Agent via a written board resolution or sole incorporator resolution. File the details of the appointed officers and the registered office address with VFSC using the prescribed Change/Appointment of Officers form. Ensure the registered agent agreement is executed and the agent is licensed under the Company and Trust (Agent) Licensing Act.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (or sole shareholder resolution)
Registered Agent Services Agreement
Consent to act as Director
Consent to act as Secretary
Registered office address proof
VFSC Appointment of Officers form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC rejects an officer appointment due to disqualification, submit a revised resolution and a due diligence package for the substitute appointment. Re-file within 5 working days of VFSC notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare Governance Records and Open Company Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and the appointed Corporate Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Establish the statutory registers (share register, register of directors and officers, registered office, charges, and beneficial owners). Ensure minutes of the first meeting are signed and placed in the minute book. Complete the beneficial ownership declaration required under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018, and lodge it with VFSC.
required_dossiers: Certificate of local agent undertaking
Beneficial ownership declaration form
Registers of members, directors, secretaries, and charges
Minute book for the first board meeting
Corporate seal
Filing confirmation from VFSC for beneficial ownership record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC returns the registers for correction, promptly update the entries, re-print, re-sign, and re-lodge a clean copy. In case of non-compliance with beneficial ownership filing, file a remediation within 7 working days and apply for a late filing extension if necessary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Business Licence Office – Department of Industry and Business Development, Ministry of Tourism, Trade, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business (for Port Vila jurisdiction: Port Vila Municipal Council Business Licence Section)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (Retail Trade – Grocery and Supermarket) under the Business Licence Act, Cap 118

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 (Environmental Registration) – small-scale retail grocery and supermarket premises; no Full EIA Report required; submit the Environmental Registration Form and site layout
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Waste Management Regulations 2018; solid waste must be sorted and collected via licensed municipal services; no industrial wastewater or VOCs generated; refrigeration equipment must be CFC-free and comply with the Ozone Depleting Substances Act No. 15 of 2009; store runoff must be contained on site and grease traps installed and cleaned at least weekly.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service (VFRS) through on-site inspection and certification of fire extinguishers, exit routes, and emergency lighting; structural load certification from the Public Works Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Public Utilities for the retail floor area; and workplace occupational health and safety clearance from the Occupational Health and Safety Unit of the Ministry of Labour confirming adequate ventilation, sanitation, and safe food storage areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue Authority (VRA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, successor to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue; primary taxpayer portal: https://vra.gov.vu, with customs declarations processed through the ASYCUDA World national single-window system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident undertaking Vanuatu retail operations must appoint a registered office/agent, incorporate a local ordinary company under the Companies Act 2012 (or register a foreign company branch), obtain a Business License under the Business License Act [Cap 245] from the municipal licensing body, and complete VRA registration using Form VAT 001 where taxable supplies exceed the statutory threshold; the entity must also obtain an importer code in ASYCUDA World for customs clearance. An International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes and is not required to register for income tax, VAT, or business license purposes because it is prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents; the IC pays only the VFSC annual registration fee and may hold trademarks, offshore procurement contracts, and foreign-purchase logistics, while the physical supermarket trading entity in Vanuatu must be the local ordinary company.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (Vanuatu International Companies benefit from a statutory 20-year exemption from all Vanuatu taxes, including income tax, VAT, business license tax, and customs duty on qualifying imports, pursuant to the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; an ordinary Vanuatu company defaults to Territorial_Scope taxation with a nil corporate income tax rate but remains liable to VAT and selected withholding taxes on Vanuatu-source consumption).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not operate an IRC check-the-box, CFC look-through, or hybrid-mismatch election regime. Available elections include: (i) conversion of an International Company into an ordinary company under Section 66 of the International Companies Act, thereby electing into VAT, business license, and customs duty exposure; (ii) voluntary VAT registration by a taxable person below the compulsory threshold under the VAT Act No. 8 of 1998, as amended; (iii) re-domiciliation election under the International Companies (Amendment) Act allowing a foreign company to enter Vanuatu as either an IC or an ordinary company; and (iv) group VAT registration or designation of a single representative for multi-branch retail and combined warehousing/export operations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) imposed under the Value Added Tax Act No. 8 of 1998, as amended (including the VAT (Amendment) Acts of 2022 and 2023 that increased the headline rate); import duty and export duty are administered under the Customs Act 2013 as parallel indirect levies; no GST or sales-and-use tax system in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 1,000,000 (approximately USD 8,300) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period, or a reasonable expectation of exceeding VT 1,000,000 in the next 12 months; a person importing taxable goods must register for VAT before the first import even when below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, certified electronic invoicing, or digital tax stamping. VAT-registered suppliers must issue prescribed tax invoices and maintain a seven-year audit trail; customs export/import and bond movements are cleared through the ASYCUDA World platform with electronic batch filing, while VAT returns and refund claims are submitted via the VRA e-services portal. Anti-fraud controls rely on ASYCUDA audit trails, risk scoring, and reconciliation of border declarations against accounting records rather than on a continuous-control e-invoicing framework.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Vanuatu no later than 180 days after supply, held outside Vanuatu, and evidenced by an approved customs export declaration qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Section 14 of the VAT Act; zero-rating also applies to services directly connected with exported goods and services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Vanuatu. A supermarket grocery hub may zero-rate wholesale exports of Asian condiments and specialty vegetables, ship-store and aircraft-supply sales outside the customs territory, and offshore services, but may not zero-rate over-the-counter retail supplies delivered in Vanuatu. The exporter must be VAT-registered, invoice at 0% with an explicit export statement, and substantiate the physical exit with the statutory document bundle; input VAT credits are recoverable solely through the quarterly VAT refund/offset mechanism supervised by the VRA, which may require export-pool accounting.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Cusdec/ASYCUDA World) endorsed by customs and referencing the Bill of Lading or Air Waybill number
Commercial invoice endorsed with the 0% VAT export notation and corresponding packing list
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a Vanuatu bank, or a SWIFT MT103/FX transaction record, evidencing receipt of foreign-currency payment from the buyer
Trader's supporting proof of export, including landing certificate or port-outward station records for transshipments through Port Vila or Luganville
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VRA conducts post-shipment export refund audits against the seven-year record-keeping obligation. A claim of 0% export VAT without actual export, with fictitious bills of lading, or overstated input credits triggers: (i) repayment of the entire refunded sum together with statutory interest; (ii) a civil penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded under the VAT Act and the Customs Act; (iii) fines of up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 12 months for false statements or obstruction of tax officers, with criminal prosecution available for forged customs stamps, sham foreign-purchaser arrangements, or fraudulent refund schemes; and (iv) deregistration and immediate reassessment of VAT on the underlying domestic supplies, including clawback of any offset or refund already granted.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — also supervises the Vanuatu National Payment System and administers such exchange control and prudential requirements as remain in force under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 81].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is effectively fully convertible. Both current account and capital account transactions are substantially unrestricted: there is no foreign exchange allocation rationing, no surrender requirement, and no export certificate precondition. Profit and dividend remittances, capital repatriation, and liquidation proceeds are freely transferable once corporate records, tax status, and banking compliance (source of funds) are evidenced. The RBV does not impose exchange-rate bands; the VUV trades on a managed floating basis against the US dollar, Australian dollar, and other reference currencies, with market pricing agreed between licensed commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory obligation to surrender export receipts to the RBV or to convert them into VUV within any prescribed timeline. An exporter (including a trading entity that is structurally an International Company) is permitted to invoice in a foreign currency, maintain foreign-currency accounts at a licensed domestic bank, and determine the timing and amount of conversion to VUV based on treasury requirements. There is no mandatory conversion ratio or holding period under the current legal regime.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Settlement Escrow Account
Operational Account and Commercial LC Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility — with significant legal and operational constraints. Offshore digital electronic money institutions (EMIs) are not licensed as banks by the RBV and cannot obtain a direct VUV clearing-bank code. An offshore EMI may be used solely as a payment-interface layer funded by transfers to and from a physical, RBV-licensed domestic commercial bank account. Because Vanuatu operates a real-time gross settlement and interbank clearing system limited to licensed banks, all VUV-denominated liquidity must maintain a local banking anchor. The VFSC does not currently confer a direct settlement or clearing membership to pure non-bank EMIs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For an International Company opening a domestic bank account, the RBV and local banks generally require physical presence of at least one director or an authorised agent for the in-person KYC interview, together with original or certified corporate documents. Certain banks may permit remote onboarding using a video call plus notarised/legalised and apostilled documents, but in practice a physical visit to Port Vila by a signatory is strongly preferred and materially increases approval probability. At least one natural-person signatory with a passport, source-of-funds evidence, and verified residential history must be appointed. Remote-only opening without any directorial travel is rarely successful for retail grocery operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure lacking local economic substance — flagged as high-risk conduit
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Register of International Companies; current international company certificate; beneficial ownership declaration; lease or service-agreement evidencing physical retail or storage presence in Vanuatu; proof of trade licence or business licence; board resolution authorising the specific account and transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-heavy grocery retail sales mischaracterised as unexplained cash deposits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed cash-management procedure; daily point-of-sale (POS) data and receipt summary; reconciliation files between till system and bank deposits; supplier invoices and inventory purchase records; VAT or turnover statements confirming declared gross sales volume.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large incoming foreign-currency injection for working capital from related-party or offshore funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder loan or subscription agreement; source-of-wealth letter from each contributor's bank; certified transfer receipt and SWIFT message; audited financial statements of the IC or group; statement explaining commercial rationale; confirmation that no sanctioned person or entity is behind the funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP exposure hidden by nominee ownership layers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete beneficial owner disclosure to 25% threshold; passport copies of each beneficial owner; independent database screening results from the bank’s chosen sanctions/PEP tooling; signed declaration of no PF/PEP affiliation; professional reference letters from the corporate service provider or filing agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Import-heavy disbursement pattern to multiple Asian foreign suppliers with no verifiable goods commercial flow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Purchase order, commercial invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, customs entry/declaration form, supplier bank and licence details, proof of vessel/airline transport path; if letters of credit are used, full LC application and shipping-document package.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections should be routed by SWIFT (MT103/MT202) to a VUV or foreign-currency account held at an RBV-licensed commercial bank, with a compliant purpose code (e.g., capital contribution, shareholder loan, or intercompany working capital) quoted in the payment narrative. Remittance details must clearly reflect the underlying legal basis and match the bank KYC file to avoid freeze or return. For larger injections, pre-advised deposit confirmation, a bank-approved company resolution, and a source-of-funds pack are recommended. The receiving bank has no exchange-control consent requirement because Vanuatu does not require currency allocation permits, but the bank’s internal AML/CFT checks apply.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlements to foreign suppliers of Asian grocery goods are executed via (i) SWIFT MT103 cash transfers from the VUV/fx treasury account, or (ii) commercial documentary letters of credit (sight or usance) issued by the local bank and advised to the supplier’s bank. Domestic Vanuatu payments may be executed by cheque, POS debit, bank transfer, or the upgraded RTGS/ACH-like rails for interbank settlement. For retained VUV liquidity, overnight deposits and term deposits with the domestic licensed bank may be used; cash conversion into USD/AUD/NZD for international supplier settlement should follow bank treasury desk FX execution.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: VUV/USD deliverable forward: standard hedging instrument for confirmed supplier invoices and expected trade margins.
VUV/AUD deliverable forward: useful given the Australia–Vanuatu import corridor and the AUD-basket peg tendency of the VUV.
Cross-currency swap (VUV/USD or VUV/AUD): bilaterally contracted with a licensed commercial bank to fix the exchange conversion on multi-currency treasury balances.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) executed offshore: permissible as an offshore-curated instrument for entities with a strong documented rationale, but not routinely available from domestic Vanuatu banks and subject to the RBV’s absence of a dedicated over-the-counter derivatives market.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company License Fee / VFSC Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June each calendar year; companies incorporated after 1 January pay a pro-rated fee computed to the next 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% on the overdue fee; if the fee remains unpaid for more than six months, the VFSC may administratively strike off the company and it will be dissolved.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company. Audit is mandatory only where the company is itself regulated by VFSC or if the company's articles expressly require an audit, or when the VFSC so directs.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS / Local GAAP - No mandatory framework; accounting records may be maintained in any internationally acceptable standard, with IFRS recommended for externally presented statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation return is due to the VFSC. However, the registered agent must keep a contemporary beneficial ownership register and must file any update with the VFSC within 14 days of receiving information. Shareholders, directors and UBO changes must be communicated to the agent before the transaction is recorded; failure to do so constitutes an offence under the International Companies Act.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required - USD 0; voluntary audit typically USD 2,000 - USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Company is wholly exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and all withholding taxes. No payroll tax or statutory tax holidays exist because the regime imposes no tax on an IC's foreign-source and exempt domestic activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return (AR-IC) filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the VFSC online portal; no corporate income tax return is prescribed under Vanuatu law.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual government renewal fee is payable on or before 30 June each calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name of the International Company, including 'Limited' or 'IC' suffix.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact registered name; the licensed agent may file on behalf of non-resident principals.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address maintained in Vanuatu at the licensed agent's premises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent will populate; no physical presence or local lease required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identity of the licensed Vanuatu registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed agent is mandatory; non-resident owners cannot self-fial.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of current directors with full legal name, nationality, and residential address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-residents; any nationality is acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholder names, share classes, and issued share capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are permissible only if held by the registered agent; maintain transparency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 6 – Declaration of No Local Business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Conformation that the IC has not carried on business within Vanuatu during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: ICs are prohibited from domestic trade; if the entity is a physical supermarket, this field will inevitably be false and triggers immediate regulatory scrutiny.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of VUV 5,000 per month; continued default attracts a VUV 25,000 penalty, compulsory strike-off, and potential personal liability of directors for any corporate obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Value Added Tax (VAT) Return (Form 3) lodged through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue online portal; required where the supermarket is VAT-registered for local taxable supplies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed and payable by the 15th day of the month following the end of the taxable month; the fiscal year-end for reconciliation aligns with the calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT charged on taxable retail sales of groceries and condiments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident legal entity must appoint a fiscal representative to file if local VAT registration arises.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT incurred on eligible business purchases and importations of inventory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only reclaim input VAT directly related to taxable local supplies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Positive excess of output VAT over input VAT payable to the Vanuatu Government.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure monthly filing reflects actual sales; zero-filing is not accepted where physical retail is occurring.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VAT filing attracts a VUV 2,000 fixed penalty plus VUV 1,000 per day; understatement of liability carries a 25% surcharge; fraudulent evasion is a criminal offence.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (no withholding tax on dividends in Vanuatu)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company and maintains no comprehensive Double Tax Agreement network. A Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) or DTA relief filing is not required domestically; however, the foreign shareholder may need a TRC from Vanuatu tax authorities for credit relief in their home jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on cross-border royalties and interest: 0%. No treaty rates apply because Vanuatu does not have an applicable income tax treaty.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None – Vanuatu does not impose transfer pricing documentation, Local File, or Master File requirements. Customs valuation and VAT rules still require transactions to reflect market value.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) are applicable only to International Companies deriving income from specified relevant activities (such as IP holding, financing, headquarters, or distribution and service centres). Physical grocery retail in Vanuatu is outside the exempt offshore IC regime and is not a permitted relevant activity; it constitutes prohibited local business requiring a domestic retail license and full tax registration. The ESR test is therefore met only as a negative finding: the IC structure itself is invalid for the stated supermarket purpose.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorized Local Business / Ultra Vires Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An International Company operating a physical grocery store in Vanuatu, buying from local suppliers, renting premises, and selling directly to walk-in customers, all of which are expressly forbidden for an IC under the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate compulsory strike-off, revocation of the licensed agent's authority, forfeiture of the company's assets to the Vanuatu Government, and a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for all contractual debts and statutory obligations arising from the illegal local trade; courts may impose travel bans, asset freezes, and imprisonment for up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate non-registration for VAT, suppression of cash-sale receipts, false input VAT claims, or misclassification of imported goods to reduce customs and VAT liability while carrying on the supermarket trade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Evasion penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded plus compound interest, machinery and premises seizure, and criminal prosecution with cumulative fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly direct or approve the fraud are personally liable for the short-paid tax and penalties; continuing misconduct triggers director disqualification, travel prohibitions, and imprisonment up to 3 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the tax-exempt IC shell merely to hold local retail inventory, collect revenue in Vanuatu, or route profits to non-resident shareholders without any genuine board direction or local commercial substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory reclassification of the entity as a local taxable company, retroactive assessment of income tax at 0% is irrelevant, but VAT and all unpaid fees become due, and VFSC may strike off the shell and fine the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally responsible for the company's unpaid supplier claims and government dues under the 'corporate veil piercing' doctrine, and may be prohibited from acting as directors of any Vanuatu company for 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to appoint an AML compliance officer, to conduct customer due diligence for wholesale grocery clients, or to report suspicious cash transactions linked to proceeds of crime through the supermarket.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Statutory penalty under Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act: fines up to VUV 50,000,000 for the entity, plus confiscation of the tainted property, and suspension or revocation of the retail license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and senior officers face personal fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and custodial sentences up to 14 years for wilful AML breaches; travel bans are automatically available to the authorities to secure prosecution.
